# Knowunity

> > Knowunity is an AI-powered study companion platform offering comprehensive GCSE and A-Level revision guides across Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and English Literature.

Knowunity provides structured study materials, exam preparation resources, and interactive learning tools designed to help UK students master core subjects. The platform features detailed knowledge hubs covering literature analysis, scientific concepts, and essay-writing techniques aligned with major exam boards like AQA.

## English Literature Study Guides

- [English - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english): English knowledge hub: 51 domains covering literature, analysis, GCSE prep
- [Classic Dramatic Literature - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/classic-dramatic-literature-3): Study guide for Classic Dramatic Literature: Priestley, Shakespeare analysis
- [Literary Character Analysis - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/literary-character-analysis-3): Character analysis guide: Scrooge, Othello, Shakespeare for GCSE revision
- [Reading Analysis and Interpretation - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/reading-analysis-and-interpretation-3): Reading and text analysis guide: Macbeth, Frankenstein, Pride and Prejudice
- [Classic and Contemporary Novels - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/classic-and-contemporary-novels-3): GCSE study guide: Jekyll and Hyde, classic and contemporary novel analysis
- [Modern Lyric Poetry - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/modern-lyric-poetry-3): GCSE English: Modern Lyric Poetry analysis and exam preparation guide
- [Romantic and Love Poetry - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/romantic-and-love-poetry-3): GCSE poetry guide: Duffy, Feaver, Dharker romantic and love poetry analysis
- [Influential English-Language Authors - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/influential-english-language-authors-3): Study guide on Dickens, Owen, Wordsworth for GCSE English Literature
- [Figurative Language and Rhetoric - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/figurative-language-and-rhetoric-3): GCSE English: figurative language, rhetoric, and literary devices guide
- [Author's Stylistic Elements - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/authors-stylistic-elements-3): AQA GCSE English: stylistic elements and language analysis guide
- [Evidence Analysis and Integration - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/english/evidence-analysis-and-integration-3): Essay writing guide: textual evidence analysis for GCSE and IGCSE English

## Biology Study Guides

- [Human Organ Systems - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/biology/human-organ-systems): GCSE Biology: human organ systems, anatomy, circulatory and reproductive
- [Cellular Organization and Development - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/biology/cellular-organization-and-development): GCSE Biology: cell structure, mitosis, stem cells, and cellular development
- [Biomolecular Structure and Organization - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/biology/biomolecular-structure-and-organization): GCSE/A-Level Biology: DNA, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids revision
- [Enzyme Structure and Regulation - Knowunity](https://knowunity.co.uk/knowledge/biology/enzyme-structure-and-regulation): GCSE Biology: enzyme structure, catalysis, and regulation study guide
